title: Loop Control Action on a Framed Configuration
statement: Let $\mathrm{body}$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and choose a base configuration, optional control state $q$, input-head position $p$, three tape contents $\mathrm{flag},\mathrm{counter},\mathrm{payload}$, head positions $\mathrm{ch},\mathrm{ph}$, output word $\mathrm{out}$, input movement $\mathrm{inp}$, optional write values $\mathrm{fw},\mathrm{ca},\mathrm{pa}$ for the flag, counter, and payload tapes, optional emitted Boolean symbol $\mathrm{emit}$, and optional next state. Applying the loop-control action to the frame configuration produces the frame with next state, input position moved from $p$ by $\mathrm{inp}$, the flag tape updated at cell $0$ according to $\mathrm{fw}$, the counter and payload tapes updated at their respective head positions according to the write components of $\mathrm{ca}$ and $\mathrm{pa}$, head positions advanced by their movement components, and output $\mathrm{out}$ followed by $\mathrm{emit}$ if present; all remaining frame data are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Base configuration of the loop host machine on $x$
Flag, counter, and payload tape contents
Counter and payload head positions $\mathrm{ch}$ and $\mathrm{ph}$
Optional write value for the flag tape
